# learning-rust-actix

> Interactive Chinese course for Rust + actix-web: lessons, quizzes, simulated demos, REST studio.

## Site
- Home: /
- Lessons: /lesson/{slug}
- Docs map: /docs
- Playground: /playground
- Studio (mock REST): /studio
- Cheatsheet: /cheatsheet
- Hub: /hub
- Lab: /lab
- Certificate: /certificate

## Tracks
1. Rust basics (ownership, Result, async, Cargo, Serde)
2. Actix intro (HttpServer, App, routes, handlers, scope)
3. Extractors (Path, Query, Json, Data)
4. Middleware & errors
5. REST (CRUD, token, validation)
6. Engineering (tests, env, deploy)
7. Advanced (stream, websocket, security)
8. Official reference cards

## Official docs
- https://actix.rs/docs/
- https://docs.rs/actix-web/
- https://doc.rust-lang.org/book/
